name: Command Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Command deck. Viewport shows a rescue shuttle holding position outside. Captain's locker against the far wall.

action.text:
CAPTAIN'S LOG — FINAL ENTRY

'Reactor alarm at 03:10. Ordered evacuation — Kovalev stayed.
Beacon active. Rescue shuttle holding at 800m.
Pod launch code: 5519.

Stabilise the reactor. Get to the pod bay. Go home.
— Captain Diaz'

Two shapes in the dark.

MERIDIAN-3 — 800m, full lights. Holding position. Patient.
A second vessel — 3km, running dark. No transponder. It blinks:
Morse. W-E—A-R-E—H-E-R-E.

Navigation display:
CONTACT ALPHA — MERIDIAN-3. Registered: HELIOS GROUP. 800m.
CONTACT BETA — UNKNOWN. No transponder. 3.1km. Running dark.

Yellow grease pencil on the display:
'Contact B = CALLISTO. Don't signal MERIDIAN-3.
HELIOS GROUP = AXIOM. They are NOT rescue.
Wait for Contact B. 148.350 MHz.'

Below the viewport: an external airlock access port — backup route to the docking ring.
